description: Java class HtmlMenuWrapperImage extends HtmlMenuWrapper, providing methods to initialize and render an HTML menu with image support, including fetching related WebSitePublishPoint entities based on menu items.

classes.name: HtmlMenuWrapperImage
classes.description: A subclass of HtmlMenuWrapper that facilitates setup and rendering of HTML menus with image support, including initialization with menu items and associated content.

methods.name: HtmlMenuWrapperImage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HtmlMenuWrapperImage with resource name, menu name, request, and response.

methods.name: getMenuRenderer
methods.description: Returns a new instance of HtmlMenuRendererImage for rendering the menu.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the menu, retrieves WebSitePublishPoint entities for each menu item based on associated content IDs, and stores them in context.
